# About the annex

The Tarrow Systems annex on Pellin Quay houses the cooling plant and two small server rooms for
the depot. Tarrow Assist answers staff questions and works the facilities queue from the annex
itself. It runs on hardware in the east room and has no connection to anything outside the
building.

The day crew works from seven to three. The night crew checks the fans and signs the board.
Questions go to the facilities office, which is closed on Sundays.
